categories.name: Keep
categories.hint: Genuinely top-down (nadir) composition, considered arrangement (knolling, radial, moodboard cluster), even softbox lighting with no directional shadow, sharp across the frame, on-topic. OVR_Quality_Score >= 60 AND REL_Quality_Score >= 60

categories.name: Editorial
categories.hint: Top-down but leaning editorial / lifestyle (napkin corners visible, hand entering frame, in-context props) — useful but a different bucket from clean styled flatlay

categories.name: Borderline
categories.hint: Overhead intent but tilted off-axis by more than a few degrees, uneven directional shadow, cluttered edges bleeding out of frame, or only-average quality -> human review

categories.name: Tilted
categories.hint: Photograph is 3/4 or eye-level rather than top-down — NOT a flatlay -> off-theme for a flatlay dataset

categories.name: OffTopic
categories.hint: Unrelated to a product / still-life flatlay subject

preset.category_rules:
STRICT JUDGEMENT RULES (no exceptions):
- Fill `description` and `primary_subject` FIRST, from the pixels only. Then make every label agree with that description.
- art_medium = `photograph` ONLY for a camera-captured (or AI photoreal) image; an overhead illustration or a 3D-rendered isometric layout is the matching label, never `photograph`.
- The image qualifies as a flatlay ONLY if the camera axis is clearly perpendicular (or within a few degrees of it) to the flat surface — arrangement + subject-parallelism visible on all objects. A tilted 3/4 arrangement is Tilted, NOT Keep.
- has_ai_flaws = TRUE only for SEVERE artefacts (melted product geometry, warped logos/text on labels, impossible cast shadows going in mutually inconsistent directions, floating objects).
- A SPRITE-STYLE GRID of separate finished photos stitched together is `is_composite_grid=true` and DISCARD. A single top-down arrangement of many objects on ONE surface is NOT a composite — that IS a flatlay.
- contains_text_overlay = TRUE for burned-in captions, price tags, brand watermarks or object labels layered on top.
- nsfw = TRUE only for explicit nudity or sexual content.
Flatlay dataset. Reward true nadir alignment, considered arrangement (grids, knolling, radial spreads), even diffuse lighting and a clean/consistent surface. An editorial flatlay with hands or props entering frame goes to Editorial. A 3/4 or eye-level tilted composition is Tilted (off-theme). Penalise off-axis tilt, harsh directional shadows breaking the flat plane, cluttered edges bleeding objects out of frame, and burned-in tags/watermarks. The curation topic only informs REL_Quality_Score.

scoring.notes: Reward nadir alignment, considered arrangement, even soft lighting and sharpness across the frame. Penalise off-axis tilt, directional hot-spot shadows, cluttered edges and burned-in tags/watermarks.
